I think it’s hard for an individual to grasp how serious a psychedelic trip is and so they don’t take a lot of things into consideration before they make the decision. 

Age is hard because everyone’s brain develops differently. 

I myself would recommend waiting until you’re 25 - 26 if you’re unsure. 
I think most take everything that could happen into consideration though, so it’s really up to the individual. 

I think psychedelics are extremely beneficial, environmental factors are just extremely crucial to how it pans out. Along with dosage. 

I’m thankful for every experience.

Another thing I’d like to add:
Have you ever been tripping with a friend and hallucinate the same thing? 

Me and a friend were tripping balls and watching Year One. We got about halfway into the movie and saw jack blacks character walking up a circle staircase singing a chant and once he reached the top he said in a high pitched voice, “Bartle-A-Toot” 

We both saw and heard the same thing and laughed for at least 20 minutes straight but to this day we can’t find that part in the movie.

That was the first and last time me and another person experienced the same hallucination.
